metadata.description: Studio Method · App + Site Kit: build a React Native app and its website, wire the services, ship to the stores, with a working style that never loses context.

plugins.name: studio-core
plugins.description: How we work: start or adopt a project, working contract, status and handoff docs, catch-up and check-out, helper agents, mockup-lab, teach, repo hygiene, and the playbook of hard rules and shared words. Harvest keeps the method growing.

plugins.name: studio-app
plugins.description: React Native + Expo apps: device QA on emulator or phone, performance passes, EAS builds and OTA updates, the Play release routine (AAB permission check, release log, What's new) and a premium store listing kit.

plugins.name: studio-site
plugins.description: The product website: a story-led marketing site (Vite, React, Tailwind, GSAP), mockups reused as live demos, an updates page, waitlist, SEO basics and Vercel deploys.

plugins.name: studio-services
plugins.description: The services behind the app and site: Supabase (local and cloud, migrations, edge functions, auth), Cloudflare R2 and DNS, Vercel, Resend + Zoho email, Google sign-in, EAS, and an environment-variable wizard that keeps secrets out of chat.
plugins.displayName: Studio Services · Supabase, Cloudflare, Vercel, email
